'''2011 US Nationals Ryan Jellison DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Jellison]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time|V1-D-imperialentanglements.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Joe Olson Deck
* '''Username:''' Sac 69837
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
